reciprocityLaw: Every trace names at least one existing case; every case and mutation control belongs to at least one trace; a case lists a trace id exactly when that trace lists the case id; every evidence owner is a named future test file for M0/build (or this package's own static test for authority-integrity).

traces.requirement: SMF headers, chunk lengths, variable-length quantities (including overlong-but-legal encodings), running status across meta cancellation and channel changes, and velocity-zero note-offs decode independently and deterministically.
Every hostile input maps to a structured refusal with the frozen code and detection byte offset - never a panic, throw, or silent skip.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (1): hostile-input refusal with structured error codes

traces.requirement: Files without tempo or time-signature metas receive the SMF defaults (500000 microseconds, 4/4) as a recorded law, never a silent repair.
traces.parentSource: SMF 1.0 defaults and the M0 window/grid derivations

traces.requirement: Tolerated metas, sysex, non-note channel messages, and alien chunks are recorded in the ignored ledgers with tick and byte offset; nothing is skipped silently.
traces.parentSource: M0 totality law: refuse or record, never drop

traces.requirement: Note on/off pairing per (track, channel, key) including velocity-zero offs; overlapping, orphan-off, and unterminated notes refuse with their dedicated codes.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (1): note on/off pairing

traces.requirement: Tempo and meter maps extract from the conductor stream with zero-tempo, invalid-meter, and misplaced-meta refusals; mid-file changes are ordinary data.
traces.parentSource: SMF 1.0 conductor conventions and the E1 writer's conductor-track law

traces.requirement: Onset quantization derives from PPQ plus meter as exact rationals: floor((2N+D)/(2D)) with half-cell ties rounding up, segment-local indices, and exact error terms.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (2): quantize onsets to a grid derived from PPQ and meter

traces.requirement: The simultaneity window is the exact tick bound floor(40000 * ppq / microsecondsAtAnchor), inclusive at the bound, derived from the file's own tempo and never wall-clock time.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (2): a ~30-60 ms window as an exact tempo-derived tick bound

traces.requirement: Sonorities group by anchored windows over notes merged from all tracks and channels, sorted by (onTick, trackIndex, channel, key), with the lowest MIDI number as bass; windows never chain.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (2): group near-simultaneous notes into vertical sonorities

traces.requirement: Measure indices derive from the meter map with exact ceil segment counts; every meter change starts a new measure.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (3): segment into measures using the meter

traces.requirement: Pitch-class set plus bass matches the frozen T1-vocabulary template table into PLURAL ranked alternatives with evidence (template, root, inversion, match kind, missing degrees) under the frozen five-key ranking; roots are never invented.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (2): infer symbols via the existing T1 vocabulary in reverse, reporting alternatives with evidence

traces.requirement: A sonority with no confident symbol yields the literal canonically spelled pitch set as a Custom chord - never an invented name.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 design mandate (4): refuse honestly when no confident symbol exists

traces.requirement: The E1 writer golden is byte-pinned into this corpus and decodes to the notes, tempo, meter, and markers the writer fixture states; its sonority resolves to the family the chord marker names, seeding the import(export(doc)) law.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2 round-trip law and the E1 accepted packet

traces.requirement: Every resource cap refuses deterministically one step past its bound on real expanded hostile bytes, at the frozen detection offset.
traces.parentSource: M0 exact-integer resource bounds and the verification discipline's bounded-work law

traces.requirement: The fixture package itself is mutation-sensitive: manifest constants match the frozen module and validator, byte goldens cannot drift, trace reciprocity holds, and provenance flags cannot flip silently.
traces.parentSource: jcpe-v3c2.1 exit criteria (mutation-sensitive contract, independent authorship)
